title: Fix this LaTeX error: Environment undefined

scenes.narration: The log names the environment, and line three shows the begin that failed. LaTeX does not predefine theorem.
scenes.caption: LaTeX does not predefine theorem.

scenes.narration: Declare it with newtheorem in the preamble.
scenes.caption: Declare it with \newtheorem in the preamble.
